name: Microwave Sweet Potato Chaat
ingredients: 250 g sweet potato, pricked or cubed
½ tsp each chaat masala and roasted cumin
¼ tsp chilli powder and black salt
steps: Microwave the whole sweet potato for 5–6 minutes (or cubes covered for 4 minutes), turning once, until tender.
Peel and cube the sweet potato.
Toss everything with the onion, tomato, lemon juice and spices.
note: The fastest version of this chaat; it needs no oil at all.
